cover_headline: Edmonton's Sneha Joy Wins $5 Million Lotto 6/49 Jackpot
facts: Sneha Joy matched all six numbers in the October 21 Lotto 6/49 Classic draw to win $5 million
Joy bought the winning ticket through the Lotto Spot app
She plans to pay off her mortgage, travel around the world and share the winnings with family

end.headline: Edmonton's Sneha Joy Wins $5 Million Lotto 6/49 Jackpot
end.line: Joy matched all six numbers in the October 21 Classic draw with a ticket bought on the Lotto Spot app, and plans to clear her mortgage, travel the world and share with family.
